full_prompt_en: A square military science-fiction illustration shows a white-haired soldier standing on pale steps before a dense group of heavily armored troops. The central figure faces forward, occupying most of the vertical space. Short pale hair falls beneath a light head covering, and a serious face looks directly outward. A gray armored vest and layered equipment cover the torso over an orange-brown sleeve, while a long dark weapon is held upright in front of the body. Worn tan boots stand on separate steps at the bottom, emphasizing a stable, frontal stance. Behind the figure, bulky companions crowd the entire upper field, their helmets, round shoulder plates, breathing gear, and large weapons overlapping so tightly that individual bodies merge into a mechanical mass. One face in a helmet is visible over the left shoulder, with an orange-lit eye area, while other heads remain shadowed or hidden. The lower steps are marked by fine gray diagrams or small printed-looking traces that are too small to read. Earthy taupe, cream, gray-brown, and muted orange dominate; near-black accents on weapons and recesses carve structure through the crowd. Fine pen-like lines describe armor seams, scratches, straps, and fabric folds, while pale scuffed color gives the surface a worn illustrated quality. Broad daylight arrives from above and left, brightening the central hair, vest, and stair edges; deep shadow remains between the packed armored forms. The overall composition is crowded and frontal, setting one clear pale figure against a textured wall of military machinery and bodies.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形军事科幻插画呈现一名白发士兵站在浅色台阶上，身后是一群厚重披甲队员。中央人物正面朝向观者，几乎占满画面高度。短浅发从浅色头部覆盖物下露出，严肃面孔直望外方。灰色装甲背心与层叠装备盖在橙棕色袖子外，一支长深色武器竖在身前。磨旧棕色靴子分别踏在下方不同台阶，强调稳定的正面站姿。其后，体形厚重的同伴挤满上部区域，头盔、圆形肩甲、呼吸装备与大武器紧密重叠，让各个人体并入机械色团。一张戴盔面孔从左肩上方可见，眼部带橙色亮光；其他头部留在阴影或被遮住。下方台阶上有细灰图形或小印刷般痕迹，太小而无法辨认。土灰褐、奶油、灰棕与柔和橙色占主导；武器和凹处的近黑色强调在拥挤群体中切出结构。细钢笔般线条描出甲片接缝、刮痕、皮带与布褶，浅色磨损着色赋予表面陈旧插画气息。宽阔日光从左上方进入，照亮中央头发、背心与台阶边缘；紧密甲胄形体之间仍有深影。整体构图拥挤而正面，以一个清楚浅色人物对照由军事机械与身体构成的纹理墙。
style_prompt_en: Military science-fiction illustration uses dense pen-like draftsmanship, overlapping engineered volumes, and scuffed earth-color washes. Taupe, cream, gray-brown, muted orange, and black are packed into a low-saturation range, with a few small warm glints clarifying depth. Fine seams, scratches, and straps create texture across large masses, while one pale central plane remains the main visual anchor. Lighting from above catches exposed edges and leaves compressed recesses dark. The composition is frontal and crowded but readable through clear value grouping. The result feels worn, technical, and formidable.
style_prompt_zh: 军事科幻插画运用密集钢笔般线描、重叠工程体积与磨擦土色薄涂。灰褐、奶油、灰棕、柔橙和黑色挤在低饱和范围里，少量暖色亮点明确纵深。细接缝、刮痕和皮带在大色团上形成肌理，一个浅色中央平面则维持主要视觉锚点。上方光照到外露边缘，压缩的凹处保持深暗。构图正面且拥挤，却通过清楚的明度分组保持可读。整体磨旧、技术感强而令人敬畏。
theme_en: A white-haired soldier standing before armored troops on steps
theme_zh: 一名白发士兵立在台阶上，身后是披甲队员
name: Masamune Shirow
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
